name: Amazon S3
reason: The bucket is Footasylum's own (fa-ecom.s3.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com): the homepage content data puts its mobile banner images there and the rendered footer links its own ESG report from it (<a title="ESG Report" href="https://fa-ecom.s3.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/footer/Inspired+ESG_Footasylum_ESG+Report_FY26_FINAL_OPTION1+(1).pdf">), so the owner chose S3 to serve website files; nothing from it was requested in the desktop crawl, and the CSP img-src does not list this bucket, so the mobile images may never load.

name: Ecwid
reason: The URL is only a platform-wide runtime setting (rtCommonProps["ecommerce.ecwid.script"] = 'https://app.multiscreenstore.com/script.js', next to flags such as ecom.ecwid.storefrontV3.enabled = false) of the site builder: there is no store widget in the HTML, no request to app.multiscreenstore.com, and no Ecwid or EcwidCart in window_keys.

name: YouTube
reason: The matched URL is only a social profile link (sameAs list and footer icon href="https://www.youtube.com/@Footasylumofficial"), which is a mention, but the site's own Content-Security-Policy deliberately allows YouTube frames (frame-src ... https://www.youtube.com https://www.youtube-nocookie.com), which DEFINITIONS counts as the site's choice; no YouTube iframe is on the homepage, so the inline-URL evidence alone would not justify it.

name: YouTube
reason: The URL is a constant in WP Fastest Cache's generic lazy-load code (if(e.tagName=="IFRAME"){var y="https://www.youtube.com/embed/"; ...}) and the page has no YouTube iframe or embed, no templates/youtube.html placeholder, an empty browser iframes list and requests only to passwordstore.it and Google Fonts.

name: particles.js
reason: particles_url is a default setting of the Ultimate Addons for Elementor plugin whose loader returns early when no element has the class (if (jQuery(".uael-particle-yes").length < 1) { return; }); no such element exists in either HTML, no particles script was requested and particlesJS is absent from window_keys.

name: reCAPTCHA
reason: _W.recaptchaUrl = "https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js" is Weebly's own template configuration present on every Weebly page; the page has no <form> element (wsite-form-field appears only in CSS selectors), recaptcha/api.js was never requested and no recaptcha iframe exists (the RECAPTCHA_PUBLIC_KEY window key is the platform's setting, not a loaded widget).

name: reCAPTCHA
reason: Same as the other Weebly site: _W.recaptchaUrl = "https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js" is platform configuration, the page has no <form> element, recaptcha/api.js was never requested and the browser saw no iframes at all.
